status: Exploratory sensitivity specified before calculating feature correlations and reduced-feature scores; not a preregistered study
selection_data: Only the 17 training participants in each original rotation; no validation or test outcomes and no model scores
correlation: Spearman correlation pooled over training trials, plus median signed Spearman correlation calculated separately within each training participant
rule: Greedy selection in the fixed feature order below. Drop a feature if an already retained feature has absolute pooled and absolute median within-participant rho both at least 0.90, with the same sign. Nonfinite correlations do not establish redundancy.
priority_reason: Retain timing, speed and distinct shape summaries before potentially overlapping displacement/end-y measures; use path length as the preferred overall extent measure. Priority is a transparent design choice, not a finding about which feature is scientifically dispensable.
generation: Reproduce frozen 120-per-person generations and original eleven-feature distances; no retraining, no change to timing or path processing
geometry: For the retained feature list in each rotation, refit only the original training feature scales and training median-distance bandwidth
inference: Average seeds within each of 28 participants. Two-sided Pratt Wilcoxon with 12-decimal differences. BH and Holm across 72 tests together: 6 compact-model pairs x 2 capacities x 3 metrics x 2 feature views (original and reduced). No test of which feature view produces smaller absolute distances.
limits: Correlation does not prove interchangeability or lack of scientific information. Distances from different feature sets have different geometry and must not be interpreted as accuracy improvements. Historical BH-140 results stay unchanged. No feature is removed from the primary report or dashboard based on this sensitivity alone.
